transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Lately I can’t seem to keep my actions in order at work—I start doing things that don’t fit what I’m supposed to be doing and everything just turns into a mess. I just don't know why I can't keep things straight anymore.
Did these attention and organization problems start in childhood or have they only begun recently as an adult?

No, this didn't happen when I was growing up; it actually started about a year ago after I left community college to work full-time at the warehouse. Before that, I was always really organized and meticulous, planning out woodworking projects and fishing trips down to the last detail. It's only recently that everything has gotten so messy.
Since these problems started, have you also had any trouble with memory, concentration, sleep, mood, or using alcohol/drugs that might explain the change?
No, I haven't really had any issues with my sleep, my mood, or using alcohol or drugs. The main struggle for me has just been all the confusion and how disorganized I get at work and at home.
Have you noticed any other new problems over the past year, such as headaches, seizures, weakness, trouble speaking, or changes in your personality?

No, I haven't had any headaches, seizures, or weakness. But I've had major trouble speaking because I get easily muddled, jump from topic to topic, and completely lose track of what I'm saying. My personality and behavior have also changed drastically—I went from being a careful planner to doing really out-of-place things like pacing and making faces at work.
Have you noticed any clear worsening in your memory, thinking, or ability to do everyday tasks over time, or has this mostly stayed the same since it started?

Yes, it has definitely gotten much worse over time. When I first started the full-time warehouse job about eleven months ago I was managing okay, but it has progressively gone downhill. Especially over the last six months, the confusion and disorganized actions have become a constant, daily struggle that has completely messed up my ability to do my job and help out at home or church.
Have you had any head injury, stroke, infection, or other medical illness around the time these problems began, or any brain scan or neurological evaluation that found a cause?
No, I haven't had any head injuries, strokes, or serious illnesses around the time this all started. I also haven't had any brain scans or neurological tests that found a cause for what's happening.
Have these problems stayed about the same, or have they clearly gotten worse over time to the point that your memory and daily functioning are steadily declining?

It's definitely gotten much worse, though it's not really a memory loss issue; it's that my ability to organize my thoughts and actions has completely declined. This started about 11 months ago and has been a constant, severe struggle for the last 6 months. It has caused major problems, like getting written up and having my hours cut at work, and people at home and church now avoid giving me responsibilities.
Have you ever had any brain imaging, neurological testing, or medical workup that found a specific cause for these changes, such as a stroke, tumor, infection, or another brain disease?

No, I haven't had any brain imaging, neurological tests, or medical workups done at all. As far as I know, there hasn't been any physical cause like a stroke or a tumor found to explain what is happening to me.
Did these changes come on suddenly after a specific event, or have they been steadily getting worse over time?

They didn't happen suddenly, but started gradually after I left community college for the full-time warehouse job about a year ago. It wasn't this bad at first, but it has steadily gotten worse over the last 11 months. The disorganized behavior and speech have really become a constant, major problem over the last six months.
Have you ever been diagnosed with a brain or nervous system problem, or had any medical tests that showed a possible physical cause for these changes?
No, I have never been diagnosed with any kind of brain or nervous system condition. I also haven't had any medical tests that would show a physical cause for what has been happening to me.
Have you ever had a head injury, stroke, brain infection, seizure disorder, or any other known brain or nervous system illness, even if it happened before these symptoms started?
No, I have never had a head injury, stroke, or brain infection in my life. I've also never had any seizures or other nervous system issues before this all started.
Have you ever had a known brain disease, head injury, stroke, seizure disorder, or other nervous system illness before these symptoms began?
No, I've never had any brain diseases, head injuries, strokes, or seizures before all of this started. My nervous system and overall health were completely fine back then.
Have you noticed any unusual beliefs or experiences, like hearing voices, seeing things others don’t, or feeling that people are controlling or watching you?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I don't hear voices, see things, or feel like people are watching or controlling me. My main problem is just how mixed up and disorganized my thoughts and actions get.
Have you had any strange beliefs, hallucinations, or a strong sense that other people are controlling your thoughts or actions?
No, I haven't had any strange beliefs or seen or heard things that aren't there. I also don't feel like anyone else is controlling my thoughts or what I do.
Did your symptoms start only after a stressful life event or major change, and do they get noticeably better when the stress is reduced?

Yes, this all started right after I left community college to take on the full-time warehouse job, which was a really stressful transition for me. However, they haven't gotten any better when things quiet down; instead, the confusion and disorganized behaviors have been a constant, ongoing struggle for the last six months.

Do your symptoms get much worse when you are under stress, or do they stay about the same even when life is calm? Also, do you ever feel emotionally numb or detached, as if you are not really yourself?
I'm not really sure if stress makes it worse because everything has just felt like a constant mess lately. I also don't ever feel emotionally numb or detached, or like I'm not myself.
Do your symptoms clearly get worse during stressful situations and improve when the stress is reduced, or do they stay about the same no matter what is happening around you?
I'm not quite sure if they change depending on stress. Ever since things got overwhelming at the warehouse, everything has just felt consistently messy and difficult for me.
Do your symptoms get clearly better when the stress is lower or when you are away from the warehouse, or do they stay just as severe no matter what is happening around you?
I'm not really sure, and I haven't noticed if they get any better when I'm away from work. The problems seem to happen just as much even when I am at home or at church.
Do your symptoms clearly get worse during stressful situations and improve when you are away from stress, or do they stay about the same no matter what is happening around you?

I'm not really sure, and I haven't noticed a clear pattern of them getting better or worse with daily stress. It has just felt like a constant struggle for the past six months regardless of what is happening around me.
Do you notice that your symptoms clearly improve when you are away from stress or on days off, or do they stay about the same no matter what is happening?

No, they don't get better on my days off; they stay about the same no matter what. These difficulties are a constant problem for me, and they happen at home and at church too, not just when I'm under stress at the warehouse.
Do your symptoms clearly get better when you are away from stress or on days off, or do they stay about the same no matter what is happening?

They stay about the same and have been a constant problem for the last six months or so. It doesn't just happen when I'm stressed at work, but also at home and at church. People there have really noticed how mixed up I get and have started avoiding putting me in charge of things.
Have you ever had hallucinations, delusions, or a strong feeling that other people are controlling your thoughts or actions?
No, I have never experienced hearing voices or seeing things that aren't there. I also don't have any feelings like other people are controlling my mind or my actions.
Have you noticed any new personality changes, loss of social judgment, or inappropriate behavior that others say is very unlike you?

Yes, my family and pastor have pointed out that I'm acting in ways that don't fit the situation at all, which is a huge change from how organized I used to be. At work, I'll suddenly stop what I'm doing to pace, wave my hands, or make faces, and my supervisor has had to call me out for it. It's gotten to the point where people avoid putting me in charge because my behavior is so out of place.
Have you had any recent head injury, stroke, seizure, infection, or other medical problem that could explain these changes, or has any doctor ever found a brain or nervous system cause?
No, I haven't had any head injuries, strokes, seizures, or other medical problems like that. No doctor has ever found any brain or nervous system cause for what is happening to me.
Have you noticed any changes in your walking, balance, muscle stiffness, tremor, or other movement problems along with these behavior and thinking changes?
No, I haven't really noticed any muscle stiffness, tremors, or balance issues. Aside from the pacing and waving my hands that I mentioned earlier, my physical movements and walking seem fine.
Did these changes start abruptly after a specific event, or have they been steadily and progressively worsening over time? Also, did they begin before age 60?

They didn't start abruptly, but have steadily and progressively gotten worse over the last 11 months after I transitioned from community college to full-time warehouse work. The most severe and confused behaviors have been constant for about the last six months. And yes, since I am only 20 years old, this definitely started well before age 60.
Do you feel that your symptoms are mainly a reaction to the stressful life change, or do they seem to be happening on their own even when you are relaxed and not under stress?

They definitely started after the stressful transition of leaving college and starting the warehouse job. But now, it feels like they just happen on their own. Even when I'm in relaxed places like at home or at church, the confusion and messy actions are constantly there.
Do your symptoms improve at all when you are away from stress or in a calm setting, or are they present all the time no matter what is happening around you?

No, they don't improve at all; they have been a constant problem for the last six months. I experience these disorganized behaviors and difficulties at home and at church just as much as I do under stress at work.
Do your symptoms clearly get worse during stressful situations and improve when the stress is reduced, or do they stay about the same no matter what is happening around you?

I'm not entirely sure if they change with my daily stress levels. Overall, the confusion and disorganized behavior have just felt pretty constant and hard to manage lately regardless of what kind of day it is.
Do your symptoms clearly get better when you are away from stress or on days off, or do they stay about the same no matter what is happening?

No, they don't get better on my days off and seem to stay about the same. These issues have been a constant problem for the last six months and happen outside of work too, like at home and at church. It's gotten to the point where people there have a hard time trusting me to follow through with tasks.
